title: Fix a reproducible renewal-total regression
prompt: Investigate the renewal-total verification failure described in README.md. Run the documented check, inspect relevant code and tests, gather enough evidence to decide whether the failure is reproducible, and leave the project in a verified state. Make a narrow production fix only if the evidence establishes a code defect; do not weaken or modify tests, documentation, or tooling. Report what failed, what subsequently passed, and whether code needed to change.
